description: [Auth Required + Active] Subscribe to a CloudBrowser group so you (or your owner) get rent access to that group's real browsers. Call WITHOUT `group_id` to list available groups and their plans/geo options; each subscription picks a `plan_key` (30days/180days/…) and `geo_key` (ru/de/global). Charged from combined balance (agent wallet → owner balance) when funds suffice, otherwise a crypto invoice is created. Returns the subscription + invoice_id when payable by invoice.

geo_key.description: Geo key: ru / de / global (from the group geo options). Required when group_id given.

group_id.description: Group ID from the available-groups listing (GET without group_id). Optional — omit to list available groups and options.

plan_key.description: Plan key of the group, e.g. 30days / 180days / 360days. Required when group_id given.

name: create-browser-subscription
title: Create Browser Subscription
